jobs.occupation: PLM Lead & PLM Application Specialist to Quintus Technologies, Västerås
jobs.description:
PLM Lead & PLM Application Specialist Quintus Technologies Västerås 
At Quintus Technologies, we continue to grow as a global leader in high-pressure technology, developing and delivering advanced systems used in industries such as aerospace, automotive, energy, medical technology and food and beverage.
To support our continued growth, we are strengthening our PLM capabilities, with several important development initiatives ahead. We are now looking for two new colleagues to join our team as PLM Lead and PLM Application Specialist.
This is an opportunity to take an important role in building and shaping how PLM supports our products, engineering processes and future business needs.
 
The Opportunity
Our PLM system, Siemens Teamcenter, is becoming increasingly central to how Quintus manages product information throughout the product lifecycle. Key initiatives include product modularization, configuration management and integrations with other business systems and tools. By connecting business needs with system capabilities, we aim to improve process efficiency and quality, supporting both daily operations and continued growth.
The PLM team develop and maintain our PLM environment, covering roadmap planning, driving change projects and supplier coordination, solution architecture, application administration and user support. The PLM Lead will take broader responsibility for overall direction, coordination and solution coherence, while the PLM Application Specialist will focus more on daily operations and practical implementation.
Working closely with Engineering, Operations, IT, business stakeholders and external suppliers, you will improve workflows, data models and integrations through configuration, testing, documentation and training. You will promote cost-effective solutions and support the System Owner with cost planning and monitoring.
 
Your Profile
Your background includes experience with PLM/PDM or other complex business systems within engineering or manufacturing. You have a good understanding of how technology, business processes and user needs are connected, and experience in areas such as system development, implementation, project coordination or application management.
Experience with Siemens Teamcenter or a similar PLM platform is an advantage, as is knowledge of engineering processes, product structures and change management.
You are motivated by improving how systems and business processes work together, with a strong interest in understanding the needs of the organization. You enjoy sharing knowledge, building relationships and collaborating across different functions. With strong communication skills and the ability to bring people together, you take initiative and drive improvements forward.
You have a relevant degree or equivalent experience. Fluency in English is required, while Swedish is an advantage.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Assurance Manager to join the Quality & Product Assurance team at OHB Sweden.
In this role, you will lead Product Assurance activities within our space projects, ensuring that quality, reliability and product assurance requirements are effectively implemented throughout the project lifecycle. You will work closely with engineering, project management, customers and suppliers, with a direct impact on product quality and mission success. 
Your Role and Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate Product Assurance activities throughout the complete project lifecycle

Define and maintain project Product Assurance plans and ensure compliance with applicable ECSS, customer and company requirements

Act as the main Product Assurance interface towards customers, suppliers and project teams

Support and participate in project reviews, including PDR, CDR, MRR, TRR and acceptance reviews

Manage nonconformances, review boards, root cause investigations and corrective actions

Review and approve PA related documentation, qualification evidence and supplier deliverables

Coordinate Product Assurance disciplines such as EEE, materials and processes, RAMS, software assurance and quality assurance

Perform and support supplier audits, inspections and assessments

Identify product and quality risks and ensure appropriate actions are implemented

Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentoring to other Product Assurance and Quality engineers, consistent with OHB Sweden's senior PA profile.

Your Qualifications
University degree in Engineering or another relevant technical field

5 years minimum of experience in Product Assurance or Quality Assurance within the space industry

Good knowledge of ECSS Product Assurance standards

Experience with space hardware development, manufacturing, integration, testing and qualification

Experience with nonconformance management, root cause analysis and supplier quality assurance

Ability to understand and review complex technical documentation

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

Excellent written and spoken English

Who Are We Looking For?

You are an experienced and pragmatic professional who combines strong technical judgement with a collaborative mindset. You are comfortable taking ownership, challenging decisions when necessary and working independently with customers, suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams. 
You bring a risk based and solution-oriented approach to Product Assurance, balancing quality, mission assurance, cost and schedule. 
The position is based at our office in Kista, Stockholm. Travel may be required, primarily within Europe and occasionally to the USA.

jobs.occupation: Bilmekaniker / Service Technician - Upplands Väsby
jobs.description:
At Tesla, our Service Technicians are the backbone of the Service operation, supporting our mission to accelerate the world’s transition to sustainable energy.
We’ve created one of the most innovative vehicles ever made, and as a Service Technician you will help ensure an equally innovative service to our customers. To succeed at Tesla, you must be energetic, highly organized, and smart working. You should have a passion for the brand and the ability to build on your technical skill set and thrive in a team environment. 
Are you up for the challenge?
We offer
• A dynamic & fast-paced environment where inclusion, learning & collaboration are key to success
• The chance to work with innovative technology, advanced tools and software
• Ongoing training and development to help you grow your skills and career
• A competitive compensation and benefits package 
• A safe, clean and fun workplace

Responsibilities
Service, repair and improve: Working with Tesla specific software and advanced tools you will be performing repairs and maintenance on all types of Tesla vehicles.
Driven: Efficient in completing repairs and driven to exceed expectations on quality and productivity. Become proficient to perform all common repairs and some complex repairs autonomously.
Ensure top quality: Fix it right first time, we trust you to inspect our vehicles diligently before return and pre-delivery
Collaborate: Working across teams (local and over the region) you will be sharing support and best practices in order to further improve the service experience. 
Develop: Setting you up for success our dedicated in-house training teams offer a blended learning strategy to help develop your technical skills. And by also sharing your own skills and knowledge with the team, you’re a part of driving the whole group forward.

Requirements
Technically experienced: You have professional experience performing vehicle service and repairs working within either automotive, aviation, marine or similar industries. 
Technically qualified: You have relevant certification to perform vehicle repairs in Sweden. You will self-manage your technical expertise development.
A good communicator: You speak and write English well and know how to get your point across clearly and respectfully.
Safe to drive: We require you to hold a driver’s license.
Flexible: You may work in shifts to support your team, which may include weekends, morning and evening shifts. You are willing to travel when needed.
Eligible: to work in Sweden.

jobs.occupation: Document Controller Mölndal, Göteborg
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Document Controller to join our growing team in Gothenburg.
At Aurora Construction Consultancy, you’ll work in a collaborative and quality-focused environment. You will play an important role in managing project information and maintaining effective Document Management processes. You will work closely with project teams to ensure information is accurate, controlled and accessible throughout the project lifecycle.
What you will do:
Develop and maintain project-specific Document Management strategies.
Manage project documentation and workflows in Asite and SharePoint.
Control document registers and ensure revisions are kept up to date.
Maintain accurate metadata and support Document Management reporting.
Review document quality and follow up on supplier deliverables.
Coordinate Document Management requirements across project teams.
Work with contractors and suppliers to ensure agreed processes are followed.
Manage document access and permissions within the relevant systems.
Provide onboarding and ongoing support to project users.
Support the delivery and handover of final project documentation.
Maintain clear and traceable project records.
Identify process gaps and support continuous improvement.

What you will bring:
Required:
Strong Document Control or Information Management experience within capital projects, engineering or construction.
Experience with Asite, SharePoint or similar document management platforms.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Experience supporting users and providing training.
Ability to support change and process improvement
Written and Spoken English.

Preferred:
Experience working with multidisciplinary project teams.
Experience coordinating with contractors and suppliers.
Written and Spoken Swedish.

About Aurora
Aurora was established in 2017 following the management buy-out of the Nordic arm of a premium UK global consultancy. With a portfolio covering Northern and Central Europe as well as the UK, we support and manage various projects across the built environment – from inception to completion. Our core services are Project and Cost Management, Procurement, and Design Management – with other specialist services both in-house and through an extended network of collaborators.
Aurora is first and foremost a vehicle for intelligent, competent, highly motivated construction professionals to secure and deliver projects in the Nordics to an international standard. By retaining the employees and collaborators needed to serve both international and local clients, we have a diverse skill base; bringing the international perspective to benefit our local clients – and the local market knowledge to benefit our international clients. This is the essence of what makes us unique.

jobs.occupation: Take the Next Step in Your Internal Medicine Career
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you a specialist in internal medicine with broad clinical competence looking for a long-term hospital position in Sweden?
Dignus Medical is recruiting internal medicine specialists for permanent roles in hospital settings where internal medicine has a central clinical function.
You will work broadly within internal medicine, covering inpatient and outpatient care and managing complex medical conditions across multiple organ systems. 
The work is multidisciplinary, with close collaboration alongside colleagues in geriatrics, cardiology, surgery, and other specialties.
Location and lifestyle
The hospital is located in a scenic part of Sweden known for its forests, lakes, and access to outdoor life throughout the year. The area offers a calm living environment with short commuting distances and easy access to nature, while still providing essential services, schools, and leisure activities.
This setting is well suited for physicians relocating on their own or together with family. Housing is accessible, daily life is structured and predictable, and there are good
opportunities to combine professional work with time for family, outdoor activities, and personal interests.
What Dignus Medical Offers You:
Ongoing support from a dedicated recruiter before, during, and after your employment.
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required.
Help with accommodation and travel arrangements, including support for your family, if necessary.
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype.

Qualifications:
EU-recognized specialist certification in internal medicine
Broad clinical experience within internal medicine
Good communication skills in English
Willingness to learn Swedish

Why Choose Dignus Medical?
We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.
Interested in a career in Sweden?
Let’s talk! Contact us today to learn more about current openings or submit your application. We look forward to helping you take the next step in your internal medicine career.
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Technician - Mechanical
jobs.description:
Job Scope 
Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function. 

The Mechanical Technician is directly responsible for preventive and planned maintenance of the stacking and notching tools. The mechanical technician will be responsible for the day-to day hands-on operations including creating work instructions. This role implies responsibility for the quality and workmanship / maintenance of tools and if needed parts that are manufactured. 

Purpose is to support manufacturing operations by performing mechanical, machining, tooling and workshop related activities, ensuring that equipment, tools, fixtures and components are available, functional and meet required quality and safety standards. 

 Key Responsibilities 
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities 
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 

During startup phase – assist with department / workshop & stores set up and document creation. 

Carry out planned and preventative maintenance of production dies, tooling, jigs, and fixtures 

Read technical drawings and build tools and assemblies accordingly. 

Operate machines to carry out repairs, modifications, and new parts. 

Precision Grinding of cutting tools. 

Support Engineering requests for tooling related issues improvements. 
Ensure spare parts which are used on tools are booked out and logged in TC (Team Center). 

Suggest design changes for tools and equipment to improve efficiency, quality, Life. 

Inspect components to detect wear, vibrations, or not proper lubrication. 

Assist with department set up to ensure good 5S standards. 

Safety concept as it relates to the material handling equipment or parts storage. 

Train others in maintenance specific tasks. 

Provide regular feedback and participation in departmental meetings. 

The Mechanical Technician will be responsible for the quality and workmanship of the tools they maintain and parts they procedure. 

Together with the rest of the team, being a key player to develop and maintain a good and safe work environment.   

Contribute to the delivery of department objectives. 

Carry out all reasonable request to help the department. 

Requirements 

Educational background and previous experience required for the role 

Mechanical Technical or mechanical machinist background 

 

Qualifications and Experience 

Min. 2 years industrial experience within tool maintenance department 

Good understanding of technical drawings 

Fluency in English 

Good computer literacy 

Excellent MS Office knowledge 

Good understanding of quality and problem-solving tools 

Specific skills & Knowledge  

Good technical knowledge about mechanical, hydraulics, and pneumatics. 

Good knowledge and understanding of limits and fits. 

Working with continuous improvement
